text: Core courses Political Economy, Western Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Monetary Banking, International Economics, Finance, Econometrics, International Trade, and International Finance. Objective This objective is to train students to be applied talents to do overseas trade and business as well as relevant work in the administrative departments of foreign trade and economic cooperation and foreign-related enterprises. This objective is to train students to be innovative talents who have the solid foundation of economics, have acquaintance with the theory of international economics and trade, and skillfully grasp modern economic analytical methods. Meanwhile, they have relatively wide knowledge, strong scientific research ability, initiative spirit and practice capability. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Economics is granted.
